decisions.reason: This organic sliced salami platter fits the firm's stated push into organic assortment and, as a close extension of the core range, is likely worth keeping after only a short time on the market.

The organic poultry mini salami snacks match both the firm's organic growth direction and convenient snack format trend, and the dedicated web presentation suggests active support rather than withdrawal.

The premium salami snack for sharing stays close to the firm's established strengths in salami specialties and variety, so in a growing market there is little reason to remove it so soon after launch.
